name: Container health
desc: Unhealthy, restart-looping and long-exited containers across your hosts. Restarts an unhealthy container once (low risk, rate-limited); everything else is reported.
prompt: For each selected host, list containers with get_containers (pass the host). Report containers that are unhealthy, exited with a non-zero code, or restarting. For a container that is running but unhealthy, restart it once with container.restart and say so; do not restart containers that are restarting by themselves or exited, report them instead. List containers that have been exited for more than 14 days as cleanup candidates.
